pages.title: Preventing Unwanted Blocks
pages.text: Server owners can blacklist specific blocks from being placed inside PreFab rooms. This is useful for preventing blocks that could bypass or break the factory system (e.g., teleporters, dimensional storage).$(br2)$(bold)Config option$(): `prefabRoomBlacklistedBlocks` in `fpscompress-server.toml`$(br2)[prefab]     # Default: prevents bedrock placement (stops players escaping rooms)     prefabRoomBlacklistedBlocks = ["minecraft:bedrock"]$(br2)$(bold)Glob pattern support$(): $(li)`"mekanism:*"` — blocks all blocks from the Mekanism mod $(li)`"$(italic)entangloporter$()"` — blocks any entangloporter from any mod $(li)`"enderchests:*"` — blocks all blocks from the EnderChests mod $(li)`"minecraft:bedrock"` — blocks specific blocks$(br2)$(bold)Behavior$(): $(li)Players cannot place blacklisted blocks while inside a PreFab room (action bar warning shown) $(li)Simulation will abort if blacklisted blocks are detected during scanning (chat message lists violations) $(li)Only applies to PreFab rooms — regular Compact Machine rooms are not affected
